verdict.rationale: There is indirect evidence of ad hoc telemetry exploration: Log Management docs exist, a user describes turning any field into a custom search dimension, and another mentions built-in Jupyter-style notebooks for correlating APM, metrics and logs. Nothing in the pack names or documents an actual query language or its syntax. Missing for 10: a documented query language (syntax/reference docs), evidence of ad hoc querying across metrics/traces/logs, and hands-on corroboration of query capability.
